title: Artifact Schema Facets
description: Give every artifact three handcrafted schema facets — 🧬️schema (every field of the artifact whatever its state class), 📸️snapshot/🧬️schema (only persisted data, no version history), 🔺️diff/🧬️schema (every change applicable to the artifact) — each expressed in five formats (🦀️component.rs, 🟦️component.ts, 🔗️component.graphql, 🔣️component.json JSON Schema, 🛰️component.proto). Move 🎒️pack under 📸️snapshot. Rename the document-state noun Projection to Snapshot. Extend taxonomy, discovery, registry, the Rust taxonomy twin and root policy scanners to require and cross-check the facets; nothing is generated, so cross-format parity is enforced by policy scanners plus a runtime table-driven test in the framework 🧬️schema module.
summary: All 54 artifacts carry the three handcrafted schema facets in five formats (810 leaves), 🎒️pack is relocated under 📸️snapshot, and the document-state noun is Snapshot everywhere while 🛢️db/📽️projection, camera projection and GIS reprojection keep the word. The artifact-schema policy family reports 0 breaches and a framework 🧬️schema runtime test validates every registered artifact's default snapshot against its normative JSON Schema and cross-checks field_states against x-semio-state. Wave 8 also repaired the gate that was supposed to prove all this: the four per-format field extractors selected the schema type positionally, so leaves with a preceding helper type (cad, curate) were compared against the wrong body — they now select by name, which surfaced and resolved 127 real breaches; the policy CLI exited 1 while printing nothing, so it now reports a per-rule tally and every high-priority breach; and validateTaxonomy never received the W1 checks its tests asserted, so the four new taxonomy keys are now validated and the nested 📸️snapshot/🎒️pack spec key is accepted (13/13 tests pass). One real format gap was recorded rather than papered over: proto3 forbids an optional label on a map field, so field parity exempts protobuf map optionality. Two misses of the earlier sweeps were build breaks: semio-framework-surface failed to compile because board-2d (a default feature) still imported Puzzle2dProjection, and the kernel's DSL fixture sweep still include_str!'d six pre-move 🎒️pack protocol paths, which had made the kernel's lib tests unbuildable and masked 26 stale test-module errors — all repaired, so the kernel now compiles and runs 695 passing tests. Remaining failures are other workstreams' debt, documented in 🧪wave8-gate-report.md: 1173 policy breaches in unrelated rule families (none artifact-schema), 395 registry findings, 42 kernel DSL grammar failures, 12 renderer UI failures, and the out-of-scope semio-compose-rs and kernel-db crates.
